purpose: The published atomic line list a star's line mask is made from (kurucz.mts, mask.mts). It is fetched once under .local/espadons/line-data and must be its pinned size.

lines.name: gfall08oct17.dat
lines.credit: R. L. Kurucz, atomic line list gfall, version of 8 October 2017
lines.use: Wavelength in air, log gf, the two levels with their J and labels, the three damping constants, the log shares of hyperfine and isotopic components, and the Lande g of the even and of the odd level.
